test_field_mask_merge_message: test the FieldMask MergeMessage method to merge selected fields from a source protobuf message to a destination
test_field_mask_union_intersect: test the FieldMask Union and Intersect methods to compute set operations on two field masks
test_field_mask_canonical_form: test the FieldMask CanonicalFormFromMask method to sort paths and remove duplicates and sub-paths
test_field_mask_descriptor_validation: test the FieldMask IsValidForDescriptor method to validate mask paths against a protobuf message descriptor
test_field_mask_json_conversion: test the FieldMask ToJsonString and FromJsonString methods to convert between JSON strings and field mask paths with camelCase conversion
